questions.question:

Shakespeare still remains the most read and the most ______ performed of all dramatists.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is:** 'widely'.**

• The given sentence is talking about **Shakespeare** still remembered as the **most famous dramatist.**
 
• The most appropriate word to be filled in the blank is **'widely'.**
 
• **Widely -** to be very different
 
 
• **Example**: The school is** widely** admired for its excellent teaching.
 
 

 **Conclusion: **Shakespeare is still admired widely.

 Hence, **the complete sentence is**:* Shakespeare still remains the most read and the most **widely **performed of all dramatists.*

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

The chef asked his assistant where he had stored the spices.

options.text: The chef said to his assistant, "Where you have stored the spices?"
The chef said to his assistant, "Where did you store the spices?"
The chef said to his assistant, "Where had he store the spices?"
The chef said to his assistant, "Where do you store the spices?"

questions.solution:
The correct option is: **'The chef said to his assistant, "Where did you store the spices?''.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in **Indirect Speech.** we have to change it into **Direct Speech.**
 
• The rules to be followed while changing** Indirect Speech** into **Direct Speech:**
 
 
• In the given sentence **'asked**' will be changed into **'said to'.**
 
• Put a** comma** after** reporting verb** and put** inverted commas** before** WH family.**
 
• The pronoun **'he'** will be changed into** 'you' **because second person will be changed according to the object.
 
• Change the** past perfect tense** into** simple past tense.**
 
• Remove** full stop **and Insert **question mark** after the statement.
 
 

** Eventually, **we got the correct sentence -*** The chef said to his assistant, "Where did you store the spices?"***

*** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__***

__​__​ The following changes should be remembered:

 
 

 **Reporting verb**
 **Reporting speech**
 
 

 **Subject**
 First person**(I,We)** changes according to the subject of the reported verb
 
 

 **Object**
 Second person **(you) **changes according to the object of the reported verb
 
 

 **No change**
 Third person **(he, she, it, they) **no change

• In **blank number 4**, we need to fill the blank with the most appropriate **preposition** from the given four options.
 
• Let's explore the **usage** of the four given **options** :
 
 
• **At**: is used to show a **state**, **condition**, or **continuous activity. It is also used **to refer to time or place, say where something/somebody is or where something happens..
 
 
• **Example:** *I was up at 6 am this morning. *
 
 
 
• *​***To : is used **to how the direction of something; towards something/someone, to show the person or thing that receives something.
 
 
• **Example**: * I'll explain **to** you where everything goes.*
 
 
 
• ***​*For**: The preposition 'for' is used to show 'purpose or function'. For is used to indicate the period of time, purpose, reason, usage of something.​
 
 
• **Example**: *Let's decide on the date **for** the next meet.*
 
 
 
• *​***On: **It is used to indicate a surface, certain side, specify days and dates.
 
 
• **Example***: Mobile phone is there **on** the table.*
